answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy roots node identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Deploying an artificial agent requires locking staking collateral that scales with exponential capital exhaustion, O(2^k), for every clone added. Like harvesting resilient timber from a managed orchard, legitimate networks withstand intrusion because sustaining a single hostile ember across a swarm costs exponentially more than any cooperative yield.
